context: A boss and his manager discuss a higher-ed sector news piece
purpose: Teach: 学長/医学部/皇室/動詞/交響曲/結晶/法科/欠如

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ケンジ君、今朝の新聞、見たかね。あの国立大の学長が辞任するそうだ。
lines.en: Kenji, did you see this morning's paper? That national university's president is apparently resigning.
lines.style: Authoritative boss tone, slightly grave, opening a serious discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、拝見しました。医学部の不正入試問題が、ついに表沙汰になりましたね。
lines.en: Yes, I saw it. The med school's admissions fraud has finally come to light.
lines.style: Respectful subordinate, measured and informed, professional register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 管理体制の欠如が原因らしい。長年築いた信頼の結晶が、一瞬で崩れたな。
lines.en: Lack of oversight, apparently. The crystallization of trust built over years collapsed in an instant.
lines.style: Older boss expressing disappointment, philosophical metaphor, weighty delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同じ大学の法科大学院でも、最近評判が落ちていると聞きました。連鎖反応でしょうか。
lines.en: I heard the law school at the same university has also lost reputation lately. A chain reaction perhaps?
lines.style: Analytical office worker, careful phrasing, offering observation deferentially.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ありうるな。皇室の方が以前ご視察された大学だぞ。情けない話だ。
lines.en: Possible. A member of the imperial family once visited that university. What a sorry state.
lines.style: Senior boss invoking institutional prestige, formal register, indignant sigh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ。記念式典で交響曲の演奏会も予定されていましたが、中止になるでしょうね。
lines.en: Yes. A symphony concert was planned for the commemorative ceremony too, but it'll surely be cancelled.
lines.style: Adding contextual detail, informative aside, polite workplace tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: だろうな。ところで君、昨日の報告書、受動態の動詞が多すぎて読みづらいぞ。
lines.en: Probably. By the way, yesterday's report had too many passive verbs, hard to read.
lines.style: Boss pivoting to specific work feedback, direct but constructive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 申し訳ありません。本日中に修正してお持ちいたします。
lines.en: My apologies. I'll revise it and bring it to you by end of day.
lines.style: Apologetic subordinate, formal keigo, prompt and conciliatory tone.
